I audited every stakeholder-facing surface except the Brand Book and logged 109 items: 78 visible, 31 only in source. (1) Site preview (r49-site-rc@738691f0). The visible copy is nearly clean. Fix before it ships:
- The Cover off / Cover on toggle on /tropos. No cover-on pictures exist, so "Cover on" blanks all seven cards, and the cover is still undecided. The fact row "Cover: a cloth disc, optional (to follow)" goes with it.
- The opening globe film, the header globe and the touch icon. They are globe_real renders that failed three honesty counts at 01:03 tonight.
- The color-dot sprite: a render not on the approved list, and it still holds a Smoke coin.
- "To be chosen" on Mantle's cartridge.
Watch items: the bronze posts (the owner asked about black at 00:28), Hemisphere's light line (redesign under way) and the name Poison (owner, 00:17).
The page source carries the history: "round 25's idea", Smoke and "eight", the Atmosphere/dome/orb routes, the owner's dated cover quote, RC review waves and commit refs, dead code for the uplight, waitlist and journal, the habitat "place" strings, and old color names in public image URLs (Fog's files are named "ice-*").
Share cards, the 404 page and all eight og images are clean. No og image carries words, and all use the approved tallr6 fronts.

(2) Live site (origin/main@856f80d7, production since 29 Oct). This is the worst surface: "Something in the air.", eight colours including Smoke in British spelling, "Put a light under it", "Eight things in the air", "all the way through", "The oldest amplifier is a shape", a corded Core, a glowing Mantle base, old figures and unapproved pictures. They also print "NOT FOR RELEASE", "Smoke, held", "record player", "PENDING ... passes the critics", "Hung low over the bar", the cover cloth and "Black is the owner's call". images.md points to the pulled backs, the pulled Dust habitat and the failed globe renders.

- The HELD notes understate the held pieces. The one-pager also has "all the way through", eight colors, lit plinths, "floats on its own light" and five unapproved pictures. The teaser's beats 1, 2, 4, 5 and 7 carry baggage, not just 3 and 6. All nine launch-grid pictures are unapproved. HELD.md's "light in the deck" note went stale at 01:05, when v4 was called unsigned.
- The deck-cover proposal and most mockups are current. Five mockups are not: signage and idea-sessions (Smoke), idea-edition ("a ninth color"), idea-milan (the uplit facade and May 2027), and idea-plaza with the house card (failed globe renders).
- The parked packs (partners, money, Kickstarter, festival) all carry eight colors or Smoke, "all the way through", the lit Mantle base and 2027 dates. The festival entry has a real deadline, 7 Dec 2026.

(4) Investor deck (version 1793686214-3dc9), history listed for the rebuild only:

- Lit plinths and the stepped or stacked horn, including the orphan "first" slide that still shows last.
